name: NICKEL PRATT
note: NICKEL PRATT on his own claim (doc 04 PRA_A1: 'Pratt on his own claim, beside Prosperity, raking'). No document describes his looks; he is drawn as room-25's composition master drew him -- big, slow, a battered hat, a rake -- then on magenta against Thad (room-25 operation 3), cut by tools/art/room25-pratt.py. His tree opens PRA_A1 in Act I, PRA_B1 from Act II, PRA_D6 once he has turned; every conversation ends with his offer (errata 97).
walkToNote: WHERE THAD STANDS TO TALK TO HIM: on the swept ground to his left, clear of the rake, facing him.
barksNote: Doc 07 writes no barks for Pratt.

sprite.frameNote: 0 leaning on the rake · 1 breath (derived) · 2 checking the sky · 3 raking, pulled · 4 raking, pushed. Breathing on 0 and 1; every `breakEvery` seconds one break -- the sky, or two strokes of the rake (errata 77). · ACTED ONLY (doc 95, errata 148; cast-unify 73): 5 his hat off, held at his chest, the rake leaning on him · 6 the hat going back on. Played by their directions, never as breaks.
sprite.statureNote: Tyler, 2026-11-06, after the leaner redraw: "scale wise, he still looks way bigger than Thad. I think his current frame needs to be scaled down to better match Thad." With his hat, his breadth and his mallet he read well over Thad at 1.03. Now 0.96 of the room's man, crown to sole: his hat brings him level with Thad. (Was 1.03: "The bigger man: room-25's master drew him 1.05 of Thad".)
sprite.figureHeightNote: ERRATA 234. Crown to sole, his hat excluded, the crown read from his eyes and chin (content/scale-anchors.json `figures`): 380. Was 363 (tools/art/figure-height.py --hat), which took a row at his eyebrows for the crown and drew him 1.01 of Thad, not the 0.96 Tyler ruled (statureNote).
sprite.redrawn: Errata 111 (Tyler, 2026-11-06): drawn from the locked cast master, cast-unify operation 19 (reference/cast-unify-17.txt), full figure, his rake in every pose so it never appears or vanishes; cut with its own pixels and a clean edge on his feet; its own file.
sprite.buildNote: LEANER (Tyler, 2026-11-06: "standing next to Thad Pratt look like a much 'thicker' character"; he chose "Leaner, still sturdy"): redrawn in the same poses, an ordinary working man a little broader than Thad (cast-unify 49), cut by tools/art/cast-unify-cut.py; figureHeight is crown to sole, the hat not counted (tools/art/figure-height.py --hat).
sprite.levelManNote: ERRATA 234: the man his sheet was snapped to one level at (errata 112 K: figureHeight 363 over stature 0.96), kept while his figureHeight is his true crown to sole. His art pixels are 0.955 of the level's (tests/one-level.test.mjs).
